name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.optimalHeavy_entropy_remainder_uniform
statement:
theorem optimalHeavy_entropy_remainder_uniform (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ), OptimalHeavyParameters t h m z →
      |h / (1 - z) - (Real.log t - Real.log ((t : ℝ) * ((1 - z) / m)) + 1)|
        ≤ 2 * h / Real.log t
proof:
:= by
  have hT : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => Real.log t) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  filter_upwards [optimalHeavy_eventually_estimates h hh, hT.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
    eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with t ht hlog ht1
  intro m z hp
  have hm : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hp.multiplicity_pos
  have hord := heavy_parameter_mass_order hm hp.root_mem
  have hL : 0 < 1 - z := sub_pos.mpr hp.root_mem.2
  have hL1 : 1 - z < 1 := by linarith [hord.1.trans hord.2]
  have he := heavy_scaled_entropy t m (1 - z) h
    (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega : 0 < t)) hm hL hh
    (by simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using hp.entropy_eq)
  have hbound := entropyTailCorrection_sub_one_bound (1 - z) hL hL1
  have hscale := (ht m z hp).2.1
  have hLbound : (1 - z) * Real.log t ≤ h := by simpa only [mul_comm] using (le_div_iff₀ hL).mp hscale
  rw [he]
  have heq : Real.log t - Real.log ((t : ℝ) * ((1 - z) / m)) + entropyTailCorrection (1-z) -
      (Real.log t - Real.log ((t : ℝ) * ((1 - z) / m)) + 1) = entropyTailCorrection (1-z) - 1 := by ring
  rw [heq]
  exact hbound.trans ((le_div_iff₀ hlog).mpr (by nlinarith only [hLbound]))

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.optimalHeavy_reciprocal_perturbation_uniform
statement:
theorem optimalHeavy_reciprocal_perturbation_uniform (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ), OptimalHeavyParameters t h m z →
      (h / (1 - z)) * Real.exp ((t : ℝ) * ((1 - z) / m)) - h / optimalValue t h
        ≤ (36 / h) * (Real.log t) ^ 2 * (1 - Real.exp (-h)) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := 1 - Real.exp (-h)
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith [Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith : -h < 0)]
  have hρ1 : ρ < 1 := by dsimp [ρ]; linarith [Real.exp_pos (-h)]
  have hT : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => Real.log t) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have htail := geometric_eventually_le_inverse_log_pow 1 hρ0.le hρ1
    (by positivity : 0 < h / 12)
  filter_upwards [asymptotic_value_lower h hh, htail, hT.eventually_gt_atTop 0]
    with t hB htail hlog
  intro m z hp
  have hm : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hp.multiplicity_pos
  have hord := heavy_parameter_mass_order hm hp.root_mem
  have hL : 0 < 1 - z := sub_pos.mpr hp.root_mem.2
  have hLρ : 1 - z ≤ ρ := by
    have := heavy_entropy_largest_atom_bound hm hp.root_mem hp.entropy_eq
    dsimp [ρ]; linarith only [this]
  have hBR : optimalValue t h ≤
      (1 - z) * Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * ((1 - z) / m))) + ρ ^ t := by
    have hlight := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (light_block_le_exp t hord.1.le (hord.2.le.trans hp.root_mem.2.le)) hL.le
    have hpwρ := pow_le_pow_left₀ hL.le hLρ t
    have hzm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp.root_mem.2.le (pow_nonneg hL.le t)
    rw [← hp.objective_eq, branchObjective]
    linarith only [hlight, hpwρ, hzm]
  have hr : ρ ^ t ≤ h / (12 * Real.log t) := by
    simpa only [pow_one, div_div] using htail
  have hRlow : h / (6 * Real.log t) ≤
      (1 - z) * Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * ((1 - z) / m))) := by
    have h0 : h / (6 * Real.log t) ≤ h / (3 * Real.log t) - h / (12 * Real.log t) := by
      field_simp
      nlinarith only [hh]
    linarith only [h0, hB.2, hBR, hr]
  have hBweak : h / (6 * Real.log t) ≤ optimalValue t h := by
    apply le_trans _ hB.2
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hh.le (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hpert := reciprocal_perturbation_bound hh.le
    (by positivity : 0 < h / (6 * Real.log t)) hBweak hRlow (pow_nonneg hρ0.le t) hBR
  have hid : h / ((1 - z) * Real.exp (-((t : ℝ) * ((1 - z) / m)))) =
      (h / (1 - z)) * Real.exp ((t : ℝ) * ((1 - z) / m)) := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    field_simp
  rw [hid] at hpert
  convert hpert using 1
  dsimp [ρ]
  field_simp
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.optimalHeavy_reciprocal_error_tendsto
statement:
theorem optimalHeavy_reciprocal_error_tendsto (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => ((36 / h) * (Real.log t) ^ 2 * (1 - Real.exp (-h)) ^ t) * Real.log t)
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ 1 - Real.exp (-h) := by linarith [Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith : -h < 0)]
  have hρ1 : 1 - Real.exp (-h) < 1 := by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-h)]
  have ht := (tendsto_log_pow_mul_geometric 3 hρ0 hρ1).const_mul (36 / h)
  convert ht using 1
  · ext t; ring
  · simp

statement:

proof:
:= by

    (fun k _ => p.coord_nonneg k)

proof:
:= by

  simpa only [hi] using p.coord_le_pushforward f i

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.negMulLog_pushforward_le
statement:
theorem negMulLog_pushforward_le (p : ProbabilityVector ι) (f : ι → κ) (j : κ)
    (hp : p.entropy ≠ ⊤) :
    Real.negMulLog ((p.pushforward f).coord j) ≤
      ∑' i : f ⁻¹' {j}, Real.negMulLog (p.coord i)
proof:
:= by
  let a := (p.pushforward f).coord j
  have hs := p.summable_coord.subtype (fun i => f i = j)
  have he := (p.entropy_ne_top_iff.mp hp).subtype (fun i => f i = j)
  calc
    Real.negMulLog a = ∑' i : f ⁻¹' {j}, p.coord i * (-Real.log a) := by
      rw [tsum_mul_right]
      change Real.negMulLog a = a * (-Real.log a)
      simp [Real.negMulLog]
    _ ≤ ∑' i : f ⁻¹' {j}, Real.negMulLog (p.coord i) := by
      apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum _ (hs.mul_right _) he
      intro i
      by_cases hi : p.coord i = 0
      · simp [hi]
      have hi0 : 0 < p.coord i := lt_of_le_of_ne (p.coord_nonneg i) (Ne.symm hi)
      have hlog := Real.log_le_log hi0 (p.coord_le_pushforward_of_mem f i)
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_neg hlog) (p.coord_nonneg i)
      simpa only [a, Function.comp_apply, Real.negMulLog, mul_neg, neg_mul] using hmul

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.entropy_pushforward_le
statement:
theorem entropy_pushforward_le (p : ProbabilityVector ι) (f : ι → κ) :
    (p.pushforward f).entropy ≤ p.entropy
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p.entropy = ⊤
  · simp [hp]
  simp only [entropy]
  rw [← ENNReal.tsum_fiberwise (fun i => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.negMulLog (p.coord i))) f]
  apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
  intro j
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg
    (fun i : f ⁻¹' {j} => p.entropy_term_nonneg i)
    ((p.entropy_ne_top_iff.mp hp).subtype (fun i => f i = j))]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (p.negMulLog_pushforward_le f j hp)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.finite_entropy_pushforward
statement:
theorem finite_entropy_pushforward (p : ProbabilityVector ι) (f : ι → κ)
    (hp : p.entropy ≠ ⊤) : (p.pushforward f).entropy ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  ne_top_of_le_ne_top hp (p.entropy_pushforward_le f)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.feasible_pushforward
statement:
theorem feasible_pushforward (p : ProbabilityVector ι) (f : ι → κ) {h : ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ Feasible h) : p.pushforward f ∈ Feasible h
proof:
:=
  (p.entropy_pushforward_le f).trans hp

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.missingMassTerm_pushforward_le
statement:
theorem missingMassTerm_pushforward_le (p : ProbabilityVector ι) (f : ι → κ) (j : κ)
    (t : ℕ) :
    missingMassTerm t ((p.pushforward f).coord j) ≤
      ∑' i : f ⁻¹' {j}, missingMassTerm t (p.coord i)
proof:
:= by
  let a := (p.pushforward f).coord j
  have hs := p.summable_coord.subtype (fun i => f i = j)
  have ho := (p.objective_summable t).subtype (fun i => f i = j)
  calc
    missingMassTerm t a = ∑' i : f ⁻¹' {j}, p.coord i * (1 - a) ^ t := by
      rw [tsum_mul_right]
      rfl
    _ ≤ ∑' i : f ⁻¹' {j}, missingMassTerm t (p.coord i) := by
      apply Summable.tsum_le_tsum _ (hs.mul_right _) ho
      intro i
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (p.coord_nonneg i)
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr ((p.pushforward f).coord_le_one j))
      exact sub_le_sub_left (p.coord_le_pushforward_of_mem f i) 1

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.objective_pushforward_le
statement:
theorem objective_pushforward_le (p : ProbabilityVector ι) (f : ι → κ) (t : ℕ) :
    (p.pushforward f).objective t ≤ p.objective t
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (p.objective_summable t).hasSum.tsum_fiberwise f
  simp only [objective]
  rw [← hs.tsum_eq]
  exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun j => p.missingMassTerm_pushforward_le f j t)
    ((p.pushforward f).objective_summable t) hs.summable

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.coord_sortedFinite
statement:
@[simp] theorem coord_sortedFinite {n : ℕ} (p : ProbabilityVector (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :

proof:
:= by

  simp [sortedFinite]

theorem antitone_sortedFinite {n : ℕ} (p : ProbabilityVector (Fin n)) :

proof:

  classical
  intro i j hij
  simp only [coord_sortedFinite]
  exact Tuple.monotone_sort (α := ℝᵒᵈ) (fun i => (p.coord i : ℝᵒᵈ)) hij

statement:
@[simp] theorem entropy_sortedFinite {n : ℕ} (p : ProbabilityVector (Fin n)) :

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.objective_sortedFinite

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.coord_sortedNat_lt
statement:
@[simp] theorem coord_sortedNat_lt {n : ℕ} (p : ProbabilityVector (Fin n)) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
    (sortedNat p).coord i = (sortedFinite p).coord ⟨i, hi⟩
proof:
:=
  coord_zeroExtend_apply (⟨Fin.val, Fin.val_injective⟩ : Fin n ↪ ℕ) (sortedFinite p) ⟨i, hi⟩

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.coord_sortedNat_ge
statement:
@[simp] theorem coord_sortedNat_ge {n : ℕ} (p : ProbabilityVector (Fin n)) (i : ℕ) (hi : n ≤ i) :
    (sortedNat p).coord i = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply coord_zeroExtend_of_not_mem_range
  rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact (Nat.not_lt_of_ge hi) j.isLt

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.antitone_sortedNat
statement:
theorem antitone_sortedNat {n : ℕ} (p : ProbabilityVector (Fin n)) :
    Antitone (sortedNat p).coord
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_cases hj : j < n
  · have hi := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
    rw [coord_sortedNat_lt p i hi, coord_sortedNat_lt p j hj]
    exact antitone_sortedFinite p hij
  · rw [coord_sortedNat_ge p j (Nat.le_of_not_gt hj)]
    exact (sortedNat p).coord_nonneg i

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.triple_amgm_of_min
statement:
private theorem triple_amgm_of_min {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) (hxz : x ≤ z) :
    27 * (x * y * z) ≤ (x + y + z) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 0 ≤ y - x := sub_nonneg.mpr hxy
  have hv : 0 ≤ z - x := sub_nonneg.mpr hxz
  have hA : 0 ≤ 9 * x * ((y - z) ^ 2 + (y - x) * (z - x)) := by positivity
  have hB : 0 ≤ ((y - x) + (z - x)) ^ 3 := by positivity
  nlinarith only [hA, hB]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.triple_amgm
statement:
theorem triple_amgm (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    x * y * z ≤ ((x + y + z) / 3) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have h : 27 * (x * y * z) ≤ (x + y + z) ^ 3 := by
    by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
    · by_cases hxz : x ≤ z
      · exact triple_amgm_of_min hx hxy hxz
      · have h := triple_amgm_of_min hz (le_of_not_ge hxz) ((le_of_not_ge hxz).trans hxy)
        nlinarith only [h]
    · by_cases hyz : y ≤ z
      · have h := triple_amgm_of_min hy (le_of_not_ge hxy) hyz
        nlinarith only [h]
      · have h := triple_amgm_of_min hz ((le_of_not_ge hyz).trans (le_of_not_ge hxy))
          (le_of_not_ge hyz)
        nlinarith only [h]
  nlinarith only [h]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.D_le_mean_cube
statement:
theorem D_le_mean_cube (x y z s : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) : D x y z s ≤ (s + (x + y + z) / 3) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := triple_amgm (s + x) (s + y) (s + z) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have heq : (s + x + (s + y) + (s + z)) / 3 = s + (x + y + z) / 3 := by ring
  simpa only [heq, D] using h

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.I1_ge_recip_mean
statement:
theorem I1_ge_recip_mean (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z) :
    3 / (2 * (x + y + z)) ≤ I1 x y z
proof:
:= by
  let c := (x + y + z) / 3
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have h := setIntegral_mono_on (integrableOn_I1 c c c hc hc hc)
    (integrableOn_I1 x y z hx hy hz) measurableSet_Ioi (fun s hs => ?_)
  · change I1 c c c ≤ I1 x y z at h
    rw [I1_uniform c hc] at h
    have heq : 1 / (2 * c) = 3 / (2 * (x + y + z)) := by dsimp [c]; field_simp
    simpa only [heq] using h
  · rw [D_uniform]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hs) (D_pos x y z hx hy hz s (le_of_lt hs))
      (D_le_mean_cube x y z s hx hy hz (le_of_lt hs))

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.sum_mul_I1_ge
statement:
theorem sum_mul_I1_ge (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z) :
    3 / 2 ≤ (x + y + z) * I1 x y z
proof:
:= by
  have h := I1_ge_recip_mean x y z hx hy hz
  have hS : 0 < x + y + z := by positivity
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hS.le
  have heq : (x + y + z) * (3 / (2 * (x + y + z))) = 3 / 2 := by field_simp
  rw [heq] at hm
  exact hm

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.heavy_tail_entropy
statement:
theorem heavy_tail_entropy (m L : ℝ) :
    branchEntropy m (1 - L) = -(1 - L) * Real.log (1 - L) - L * Real.log (L / m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold branchEntropy
  rw [show 1 - (1 - L) = L by ring]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.heavy_tail_objective
statement:
theorem heavy_tail_objective (m L : ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    branchObjective m t (1 - L) = (1 - L) * L ^ t + L * (1 - L / m) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  unfold branchObjective
  rw [show 1 - (1 - L) = L by ring]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.heavy_tail_entropy_correction
statement:
theorem heavy_tail_entropy_correction (m L : ℝ) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    branchEntropy m (1 - L) = L * (Real.log (m / L) + entropyTailCorrection L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [heavy_tail_entropy, Real.log_div hm hL, Real.log_div hL hm]
  unfold entropyTailCorrection
  field_simp
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.entropyTailCorrection_remainder_bound
statement:
theorem entropyTailCorrection_remainder_bound (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hL1 : L < 1) :
    |entropyTailCorrection L - (1 - L / 2)| ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * L ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := Real.abs_log_sub_add_sum_range_le (x := L)
    (by rw [abs_of_pos hL]; exact hL1) 2
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hlog
  rw [abs_of_pos hL] at hlog
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ (1 - L) / L := div_nonneg (by linarith) hL.le
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hfactor
  have hcancel : (1 - L) / L * (L ^ 3 / (1 - L)) = L ^ 2 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hL1)]
  rw [hcancel, ← abs_of_nonneg hfactor, ← abs_mul] at hmul
  have hid : entropyTailCorrection L - (1 - L / 2) =
      -((1 - L) / L * (L + L ^ 2 / 2 + Real.log (1 - L))) - L ^ 2 / 2 := by
    unfold entropyTailCorrection
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hid]
  calc
    _ ≤ |-((1 - L) / L * (L + L ^ 2 / 2 + Real.log (1 - L)))| + |L ^ 2 / 2| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ L ^ 2 + L ^ 2 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ L ^ 2 / 2)]
      linarith only [hmul]
    _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) * L ^ 2 := by ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.entropyTailCorrection_expansion
statement:
theorem entropyTailCorrection_expansion :
    (fun L : ℝ => entropyTailCorrection L - (1 - L / 2)) =O[𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)]
      (fun L => L ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Asymptotics.isBigO_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨3 / 2, ?_⟩
  have he : ∀ᶠ L : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), L < 1 :=
    (eventually_lt_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, he] with L hL hL1
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg L)] using
    entropyTailCorrection_remainder_bound L hL hL1

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.entropyTailCorrection_bounds
statement:
theorem entropyTailCorrection_bounds (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hL1 : L < 1) :
    0 < entropyTailCorrection L ∧ entropyTailCorrection L ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : Real.log (1 - L) < 0 := Real.log_neg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  constructor
  · unfold entropyTailCorrection
    exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hL) hlog
  · have hlo := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (show 0 < 1 - L by linarith)
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo (show 0 ≤ (1 - L) / L by positivity)
    have hid : (1 - L) / L * (1 - (1 - L)⁻¹) = -1 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hL, ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hL1)]
      ring
    rw [hid] at hmul
    unfold entropyTailCorrection
    rw [neg_div, neg_mul]
    linarith only [hmul]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.heavy_tail_entropy_inversion
statement:
theorem heavy_tail_entropy_inversion (m L h : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (hh : 0 < h)
    (he : branchEntropy m (1 - L) = h) :
    h / L = Real.log (m / h) + Real.log (h / L) + entropyTailCorrection L
proof:
:= by
  have he' := heavy_tail_entropy_correction m L (ne_of_gt hm) (ne_of_gt hL)
  have hid : Real.log (m / h) + Real.log (h / L) = Real.log (m / L) := by
    rw [← Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos hm hh)) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hh hL))]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [hid]
  apply (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hL)).mpr
  rw [← he, he']
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.candidateCoord_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem candidateCoord_zero (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : candidateCoord m z 0 = z
proof: := rfl

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.candidateCoord_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem candidateCoord_succ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (i : Fin m) :
    candidateCoord m z i.succ = (1 - z) / (m : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.sum_candidateCoord
statement:
theorem sum_candidateCoord {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (z : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, candidateCoord m z i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [candidateCoord_zero, candidateCoord_succ, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hm)
  field_simp
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.candidateCoord_nonneg
statement:
theorem candidateCoord_nonneg {m : ℕ} {z : ℝ} (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) : 0 ≤ candidateCoord m z i
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · exact hz.1
  · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hz.2) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.hasSum_candidateCoord
statement:
theorem hasSum_candidateCoord {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (z : ℝ) :
    HasSum (candidateCoord m z) 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sum_candidateCoord hm] using hasSum_fintype (candidateCoord m z)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.coord_candidateVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem coord_candidateVector (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) : (candidateVector m z hm hz).coord = candidateCoord m z
proof: := rfl

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.sum_negMulLog_candidateCoord
statement:
theorem sum_negMulLog_candidateCoord {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (z : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, Real.negMulLog (candidateCoord m z i)) = branchEntropy m z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [candidateCoord_zero, candidateCoord_succ, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Real.negMulLog, branchEntropy]
  have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hm)
  field_simp
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.entropy_candidateVector
statement:
theorem entropy_candidateVector (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    (candidateVector m z hm hz).entropy = ENNReal.ofReal (branchEntropy m z)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (candidateVector m z hm hz).entropy ≠ ⊤ :=
    (ProbabilityVector.entropy_ne_top_iff _).2 (hasSum_fintype _).summable
  rw [ProbabilityVector.entropy_eq_ofReal_tsum _ hp, coord_candidateVector,
    tsum_fintype, sum_negMulLog_candidateCoord hm]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.objective_candidateVector
statement:
theorem objective_candidateVector (m t : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    (candidateVector m z hm hz).objective t = branchObjective m t z
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProbabilityVector.objective, coord_candidateVector, tsum_fintype, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [candidateCoord_zero, candidateCoord_succ, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, missingMassTerm, branchObjective]
  have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hm)
  field_simp

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.candidateCoord_uniform
statement:
theorem candidateCoord_uniform {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    candidateCoord m (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) i = 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · rfl
  · simp only [candidateCoord_succ]
    have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hm)
    have hm1 : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.candidateCoord_pos
statement:
theorem candidateCoord_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {z : ℝ} (hz : z ∈ Ioo 0 1)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) : 0 < candidateCoord m z i
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · exact hz.1
  · exact div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hz.2) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.candidateVector_feasible
statement:
theorem candidateVector_feasible {m : ℕ} {z h : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) (he : branchEntropy m z ≤ h) :
    candidateVector m z hm hz ∈ ProbabilityVector.Feasible h
proof:
:= by
  change (candidateVector m z hm hz).entropy ≤ ENNReal.ofReal h
  rw [entropy_candidateVector]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal he

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.coord_natCandidateVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem coord_natCandidateVector (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (natCandidateVector m z hm hz).coord i.val = candidateCoord m z i
proof:
:=
  ProbabilityVector.coord_zeroExtend_apply _ _ i

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.coord_natCandidateVector_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coord_natCandidateVector_eq_zero (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) (n : ℕ) (hn : m + 1 ≤ n) :
    (natCandidateVector m z hm hz).coord n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ProbabilityVector.coord_zeroExtend_of_not_mem_range
  rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hi' : i.val = n := hi
  exact Nat.not_lt_of_ge hn (hi' ▸ i.isLt)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.entropy_natCandidateVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem entropy_natCandidateVector (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    (natCandidateVector m z hm hz).entropy = ENNReal.ofReal (branchEntropy m z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [natCandidateVector, ProbabilityVector.entropy_zeroExtend, entropy_candidateVector]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.objective_natCandidateVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem objective_natCandidateVector (m t : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    (natCandidateVector m z hm hz).objective t = branchObjective m t z
proof:
:= by
  rw [natCandidateVector, ProbabilityVector.objective_zeroExtend, objective_candidateVector]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.natCandidateVector_finite_support
statement:
theorem natCandidateVector_finite_support (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) : (Function.support (natCandidateVector m z hm hz).coord).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply (Set.finite_range (candidateIndexEmbedding m)).subset
  intro n hn
  by_contra hnot
  exact hn (ProbabilityVector.coord_zeroExtend_of_not_mem_range _ _ n hnot)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.natCandidateVector_feasible
statement:
theorem natCandidateVector_feasible {m : ℕ} {z h : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc 0 1) (he : branchEntropy m z ≤ h) :
    natCandidateVector m z hm hz ∈ ProbabilityVector.Feasible h
proof:
:= by
  change (natCandidateVector m z hm hz).entropy ≤ ENNReal.ofReal h
  rw [entropy_natCandidateVector]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal he

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.entropySupportIndex_eq_of_log_bounds
statement:
theorem entropySupportIndex_eq_of_log_bounds {h : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hl : Real.log k ≤ h) (hu : h < Real.log (k+1 : ℕ)) : entropySupportIndex h = k
proof:
:= by
  apply (Nat.floor_eq_iff (Real.exp_pos h).le).mpr
  constructor
  · exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hk)).mp hl
  · have hh := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (show (0 : ℝ) < (k+1 : ℕ) by positivity)).mp hu
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hh

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.heavyRoot_mem_of_entropy_signs
statement:
theorem heavyRoot_mem_of_entropy_signs {h a b : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hm : entropySupportIndex h ≤ m)
    (ha : a ∈ Icc (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) 1) (hb : b ∈ Icc (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) 1)
    (hea : h < branchEntropy m a) (heb : branchEntropy m b < h) :
    heavyRoot h m ∈ Ioo a b
proof:
:= by
  have hmp : 0 < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr ((entropySupportIndex_pos hh.le).trans_le hm)
  have hs := heavyRoot_spec hh (heavy_domain_of_index hm)
  have hmono := (strictAntiOn_branchEntropy hmp).antitoneOn
  have hroot : heavyRoot h m ∈ Icc (1/((m : ℝ)+1)) 1 := ⟨hs.1.1.le,hs.1.2.le⟩
  constructor
  · by_contra hn
    have he := hmono hroot ha (le_of_not_gt hn)
    rw [hs.2] at he
    linarith
  · by_contra hn
    have he := hmono hb hroot (le_of_not_gt hn)
    rw [hs.2] at he
    linarith

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.lightRoot_mem_of_entropy_signs
statement:
theorem lightRoot_mem_of_entropy_signs {h a b : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h)
    (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 (1/((entropySupportIndex h : ℝ)+1)))
    (hb : b ∈ Icc 0 (1/((entropySupportIndex h : ℝ)+1)))
    (hea : branchEntropy (entropySupportIndex h) a < h)
    (heb : h < branchEntropy (entropySupportIndex h) b) : lightRoot h ∈ Ioo a b
proof:
:= by
  have hs := lightRoot_spec hh
  have hmono := (strictMonoOn_branchEntropy (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (entropySupportIndex_pos hh.le))).monotoneOn
  have hr : lightRoot h ∈ Icc 0 (1/((entropySupportIndex h : ℝ)+1)) := ⟨hs.1.1,hs.1.2.le⟩
  constructor
  · by_contra hn
    have he := hmono hr ha (le_of_not_gt hn)
    rw [hs.2] at he
    linarith
  · by_contra hn
    have he := hmono hb hr (le_of_not_gt hn)
    rw [hs.2] at he
    linarith

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.finite_fiber
statement:
theorem finite_fiber (p : ProbabilityVector ι) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Set.Finite {i | p.coord i = a}
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.finite_coe_iff.mp
  apply Finite.of_summable_const ha
  have hs := p.summable_coord.subtype (fun i => p.coord i = a)
  exact hs.congr (fun i => i.property)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.finite_support_of_finite_sizes
statement:
theorem finite_support_of_finite_sizes (p : ProbabilityVector ι) {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : s.Finite) (hpos : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 < a)
    (hcovers : ∀ i, p.coord i ≠ 0 → p.coord i ∈ s) :
    (Function.support p.coord).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hu := hs.biUnion (fun a ha => p.finite_fiber (hpos a ha))
  apply hu.subset
  intro i hi
  exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p.coord i, hcovers i hi, rfl⟩

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.finite_support_of_two_sizes
statement:
theorem finite_support_of_two_sizes (p : ProbabilityVector ι) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (h : ∀ i, p.coord i = 0 ∨ p.coord i = a ∨ p.coord i = b) :
    (Function.support p.coord).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply ((p.finite_fiber ha).union (p.finite_fiber hb)).subset
  intro i hi
  rcases h i with hz | hsize
  · exact (hi hz).elim
  · exact hsize

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.exists_coord_pos
statement: theorem exists_coord_pos (p : ProbabilityVector ι) : ∃ i, 0 < p.coord i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hz : p.coord = 0 := funext (fun i => le_antisymm (h i) (p.coord_nonneg i))
  have hm := p.tsum_coord
  rw [hz] at hm
  simp at hm

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.coord_eq_zero_of_coord_eq_one
statement:
theorem coord_eq_zero_of_coord_eq_one (p : ProbabilityVector ι) {i j : ι}
    (hi : p.coord i = 1) (hji : j ≠ i) : p.coord j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum := p.summable_coord.sum_le_tsum ({i, j} : Finset ι)
    (fun k _ => p.coord_nonneg k)
  rw [p.tsum_coord] at hsum
  have hij : i ≠ j := Ne.symm hji
  simp only [Finset.sum_insert (Finset.notMem_singleton.mpr hij),
    Finset.sum_singleton, hi] at hsum
  exact le_antisymm (by linarith) (p.coord_nonneg j)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.entropy_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem entropy_eq_zero_iff (p : ProbabilityVector ι) :
    p.entropy = 0 ↔ ∃ i, p.coord i = 1 ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ i → p.coord j = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := p.exists_coord_pos
    have he : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.negMulLog (p.coord i)) = 0 :=
      ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.mp h i
    have he' := ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp he
    have hi1 : p.coord i = 1 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hlt : p.coord i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (p.coord_le_one i) hn
      have hp : 0 < Real.negMulLog (p.coord i) :=
        mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (neg_neg_of_pos hi) (Real.log_neg hi hlt)
      exact (not_lt_of_ge he') hp
    exact ⟨i, hi1, fun j hj => p.coord_eq_zero_of_coord_eq_one hi1 hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hz⟩
    apply ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.mpr
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · simp [hji, hi]
    · simp [hz j hji]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.objective_eq_zero_of_entropy_eq_zero
statement:
theorem objective_eq_zero_of_entropy_eq_zero (p : ProbabilityVector ι) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (h : p.entropy = 0) : p.objective t = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hz⟩ := p.entropy_eq_zero_iff.mp h
  unfold objective
  calc
    (∑' j, missingMassTerm t (p.coord j)) = ∑' _ : ι, (0 : ℝ) := by
      apply tsum_congr
      intro j
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · simp [missingMassTerm, hji, hi, Nat.ne_zero_of_lt ht]
      · simp [missingMassTerm, hz j hji]
    _ = 0 := by simp

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.feasible_zero_iff
statement:
theorem feasible_zero_iff (p : ProbabilityVector ι) :
    p ∈ (Feasible 0 : Set (ProbabilityVector ι)) ↔ p.entropy = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Feasible]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.entropy_eq_zero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem entropy_eq_zero_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton ι] (p : ProbabilityVector ι) :
    p.entropy = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := p.exists_coord_pos
  have hi : p.coord i = 1 := by
    rw [← p.tsum_coord, tsum_eq_single i]
    intro j hj
    exact (hj (Subsingleton.elim j i)).elim
  exact p.entropy_eq_zero_iff.mpr
    ⟨i, hi, fun j hj => (hj (Subsingleton.elim j i)).elim⟩

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.coord_le_recip_of_antitone
statement:
theorem coord_le_recip_of_antitone (p : ProbabilityVector ℕ) (hp : Antitone p.coord) (n : ℕ) :
    p.coord n ≤ 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * p.coord n ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      ((n : ℝ) + 1) * p.coord n = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), p.coord n := by simp
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), p.coord i := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        exact hp (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
      _ ≤ ∑' i, p.coord i := p.summable_coord.sum_le_tsum _ (fun i _ => p.coord_nonneg i)
      _ = 1 := p.tsum_coord
  exact (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hsum)

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.tsum_entropy_le_of_feasible
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite : p.entropy ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hp
  have ht := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hp
  simpa only [p.entropy_toReal hfinite, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hh] using ht

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.mul_log_le_negMulLog
statement:
theorem mul_log_le_negMulLog {u a : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (_ha : 0 < a) (hbound : u ≤ 1 / a) :
    u * Real.log a ≤ Real.negMulLog u
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hu with rfl | hu
  · simp
  · have hlog := Real.log_le_log hu hbound
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv] at hlog
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hu.le
    simp only [Real.negMulLog]
    nlinarith

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.sorted_tail_le
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hN)
  have hfinite : p.entropy ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hbudget
  have hsEntropy := p.entropy_ne_top_iff.mp hfinite
  have hterm : ∀ i : {n : ℕ // N ≤ n},
      p.coord i * Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.negMulLog (p.coord i) := by
    intro i
    apply mul_log_le_negMulLog (p.coord_nonneg i) (by positivity)
    exact (hp i.property).trans (p.coord_le_recip_of_antitone hp N)
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hlog).mpr
  calc
    (∑' i : {n : ℕ // N ≤ n}, p.coord i) * Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) =
        ∑' i : {n : ℕ // N ≤ n}, p.coord i * Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) := by rw [tsum_mul_right]
    _ ≤ ∑' i : {n : ℕ // N ≤ n}, Real.negMulLog (p.coord i) :=
      ((p.summable_coord.subtype (N ≤ ·)).mul_right _).tsum_le_tsum hterm
        (hsEntropy.subtype (N ≤ ·))
    _ ≤ ∑' i, Real.negMulLog (p.coord i) :=
      hsEntropy.tsum_subtype_le _ _ p.entropy_term_nonneg
    _ ≤ h := p.tsum_entropy_le_of_feasible hh hbudget

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.tendsto_entropy_tail_bound
statement:
theorem tendsto_entropy_tail_bound (h : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => h / Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp
    (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)).const_div_atTop h

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.ProbabilityVector.uniform_sorted_tail
statement:
theorem uniform_sorted_tail {h ε : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ p : ProbabilityVector ℕ,
      Antitone p.coord → p.entropy ≤ ENNReal.ofReal h →
      (∑' i : {k : ℕ // n ≤ k}, |p.coord i|) < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    ((tendsto_entropy_tail_bound h).eventually_lt_const hε)
  refine ⟨max N 1, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro n hn p hp hbudget
  simp only [abs_of_nonneg (p.coord_nonneg _)]
  exact (p.sorted_tail_le hp hh hbudget n ((le_max_right N 1).trans hn)).trans_lt
    (hN n ((le_max_left N 1).trans hn))

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.affine_segment_pos
statement:
private theorem affine_segment_pos (a b u : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : 0 < a + (b - a) * u
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu0 : u = 0
  · simpa [hu0] using ha
  · have hup : 0 < u := lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1 (Ne.symm hu0)
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (1 - u) * a := mul_nonneg (by linarith [hu.2]) (le_of_lt ha)
    have h2 := mul_pos hup hb
    nlinarith

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.integral_affine_inv_cube
statement:
theorem integral_affine_inv_cube (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, 1 / (a + (b - a) * v) ^ 3) =
      (a + b) / (2 * a ^ 2 * b ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => v * (2 * a + (b - a) * v) /
    (2 * a ^ 2 * (a + (b - a) * v) ^ 2)
  have hd : ∀ v ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt F (1 / (a + (b - a) * v) ^ 3) v := by
    intro v hv
    have hbase := affine_segment_pos a b v ha hb (by simpa using hv)
    have hNum := (hasDerivAt_id v).mul
      (((hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (b - a)).const_add (2 * a))
    have hDen := ((((hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (b - a)).const_add a).fun_pow 2).const_mul (2 * a ^ 2)
    convert hNum.div hDen (by positivity) using 1
    · rfl
    · simp only [id_eq, Pi.mul_apply]
      norm_num
      field_simp
      ring
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => 1 / (a + (b - a) * v) ^ 3) (Icc 0 1) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.div
    · fun_prop
    · fun_prop
    · intro v hv
      exact pow_ne_zero _ (ne_of_gt (affine_segment_pos a b v ha hb hv))
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => 1 / (a + (b - a) * v) ^ 3) volume 0 1 :=
    hcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd hi]
  simp [F]
  field_simp
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.integral_outer_inverse
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => z + (x - z) * u
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => y + (x - y) * u
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => -(1 - u) ^ 2 / (x * A u * B u)
  have hd : ∀ u ∈ uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt F
      ((1 - u) * (A u + B u) / ((A u) ^ 2 * (B u) ^ 2)) u := by
    intro u hu
    have hA : 0 < A u := affine_segment_pos z x u hz hx (by simpa using hu)
    have hB : 0 < B u := affine_segment_pos y x u hy hx (by simpa using hu)
    have hNum := (((hasDerivAt_id u).const_sub 1).fun_pow 2).neg
    have hDA := ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (x - z)).const_add z
    have hDB := ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (x - y)).const_add y
    have hDen := (hDA.const_mul x).mul hDB
    convert hNum.div hDen (by change x * A u * B u ≠ 0; positivity) using 1
    · rfl
    · dsimp [A, B] at *
      norm_num
      field_simp
      ring
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun u => (1 - u) * (A u + B u) / ((A u) ^ 2 * (B u) ^ 2))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.div
    · dsimp [A, B]; fun_prop
    · dsimp [A, B]; fun_prop
    · intro u hu
      have hA : 0 < A u := affine_segment_pos z x u hz hx hu
      have hB : 0 < B u := affine_segment_pos y x u hy hx hu
      positivity
  have hi : IntervalIntegrable (fun u => (1 - u) * (A u + B u) / ((A u) ^ 2 * (B u) ^ 2))
      volume 0 1 := hcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num)
  change (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - u) * (A u + B u) / ((A u) ^ 2 * (B u) ^ 2)) = _
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd hi]
  simp [F, A, B]
  field_simp

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.simplex_inverse_cube
statement:
theorem simplex_inverse_cube (x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, 2 * (1 - u) *
      ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, 1 / (simplexValue x y z u v) ^ 3) = 1 / (x * y * z)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, 2 * (1 - u) *
      ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, 1 / (simplexValue x y z u v) ^ 3) =
      ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - u) * ((z + (x - z) * u) + (y + (x - y) * u)) /
        ((z + (x - z) * u) ^ 2 * (y + (x - y) * u) ^ 2) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro u hu
    have hu' : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by simpa using hu
    have hA := affine_segment_pos z x u hz hx hu'
    have hB := affine_segment_pos y x u hy hx hu'
    have hinner : (fun v : ℝ => 1 / (simplexValue x y z u v) ^ 3) =
        (fun v : ℝ => 1 / ((z + (x - z) * u) +
          ((y + (x - y) * u) - (z + (x - z) * u)) * v) ^ 3) := by
      funext v
      congr 2
      unfold simplexValue
      ring
    dsimp only
    rw [hinner, integral_affine_inv_cube _ _ hA hB]
    field_simp
  rw [heq, integral_outer_inverse x y z hx hy hz]

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.simplexValue_add
statement:
theorem simplexValue_add (x y z s u v : ℝ) :
    simplexValue (s + x) (s + y) (s + z) u v = s + simplexValue x y z u v
proof:
:= by
  unfold simplexValue
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.simplex_denominator_representation
statement:
theorem simplex_denominator_representation (x y z s : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, 2 * (1 - u) *
      ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, 1 / (s + simplexValue x y z u v) ^ 3) = 1 / D x y z s
proof:
:= by
  have h := simplex_inverse_cube (s + x) (s + y) (s + z) (by positivity) (by positivity) (by positivity)
  simpa only [simplexValue_add, D] using h

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.simplexValue_mem
statement:
theorem simplexValue_mem (x y z a b u v : ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ Icc a b) (hy : y ∈ Icc a b) (hz : z ∈ Icc a b)
    (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hv : v ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    simplexValue x y z u v ∈ Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 - u) * v := mul_nonneg (by linarith [hu.2]) hv.1
  have h3 : 0 ≤ (1 - u) * (1 - v) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith [hu.2]) (by linarith [hv.2])
  constructor
  · have h := add_le_add (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.1 hu.1)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.1 h2)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz.1 h3)
    convert h using 1 <;> (try unfold simplexValue) <;> ring
  · have h := add_le_add (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 hu.1)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.2 h2)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz.2 h3)
    convert h using 1 <;> (try unfold simplexValue) <;> ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.integral_poly_two
statement:
private theorem integral_poly_two (A B C : ℝ) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, A * u ^ 2 + B * u + C) = A / 3 + B / 2 + C
proof:
:= by
  have hA : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => A * u ^ 2) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hB : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => B * u) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).intervalIntegrable _ _
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hA.add hB) intervalIntegrable_const,
    intervalIntegral.integral_add hA hB, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  norm_num
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.integral_poly_three
proof:
:= by
  have hA : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => A * u ^ 3) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.pow 3)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hB : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => B * u ^ 2 + C * u + D) volume 0 1 := by
    apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    fun_prop
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hA hB, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
    integral_poly_two]
  norm_num
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.simplex_inner_moments
statement:
private theorem simplex_inner_moments (x y z u : ℝ) :
    (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, simplexValue x y z u v) =
      (z + (x - z) * u) + ((1 - u) * (y - z)) / 2 ∧
    (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (simplexValue x y z u v) ^ 2) =
      (z + (x - z) * u) ^ 2 + (z + (x - z) * u) * ((1 - u) * (y - z)) +
        ((1 - u) * (y - z)) ^ 2 / 3
proof:
:= by
  let A := z + (x - z) * u
  let B := (1 - u) * (y - z)
  constructor
  · have heq : (fun v : ℝ => simplexValue x y z u v) =
        (fun v : ℝ => 0 * v ^ 2 + B * v + A) := by funext v; dsimp [A, B, simplexValue]; ring
    rw [heq, integral_poly_two]
    dsimp [A, B]
    ring
  · have heq : (fun v : ℝ => (simplexValue x y z u v) ^ 2) =
        (fun v : ℝ => B ^ 2 * v ^ 2 + (2 * A * B) * v + A ^ 2) := by
      funext v
      dsimp [A, B, simplexValue]
      ring
    rw [heq, integral_poly_two]
    dsimp [A, B]
    ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.simplex_first_moment
statement:
theorem simplex_first_moment (x y z : ℝ) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, 2 * (1 - u) *
      ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, simplexValue x y z u v) = (x + y + z) / 3
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun u : ℝ => 2 * (1 - u) * ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, simplexValue x y z u v) =
      (fun u : ℝ => (-2 * x + y + z) * u ^ 2 + (2 * x - 2 * y - 2 * z) * u + (y + z)) := by
    funext u
    rw [(simplex_inner_moments x y z u).1]
    ring
  rw [heq, integral_poly_two]
  ring

name: EntropyConstrainedMissingMass.Curvature.simplex_second_moment
statement:
theorem simplex_second_moment (x y z : ℝ) :
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, 2 * (1 - u) *
      ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (simplexValue x y z u v) ^ 2) =
      (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2 + x * y + x * z + y * z) / 6
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun u : ℝ => 2 * (1 - u) * ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (simplexValue x y z u v) ^ 2) =

        (2 * x * y + 2 * x * z - 2 * y ^ 2 - 2 * y * z - 2 * z ^ 2) * u +
        (2 * y ^ 2 / 3 + 2 * y * z / 3 + 2 * z ^ 2 / 3))) := by
    funext u
    rw [(simplex_inner_moments x y z u).2]

theorem weightedCoefficient_ratio_strict {β x y z : ℝ}
    (hβx : x < β) (hxy : y < x) (hyz : z < y) (hz : 0 < z) (n : ℕ)
    (hpos : 0 < weightedCoefficient β x y z (n + 1)) :
    weightedCoefficient β x y z (n + 2) / weightedCoefficient β x y z (n + 1) <

proof:
:= by
  have hprev := weightedCoefficient_prev_pos (hz.trans (hyz.trans hxy)) (hz.trans hyz) hz hpos

  have h := weightedCoefficient_strict_log_concave hβx hxy hyz hz n hprev
  nlinarith only [h]
